verdict.rationale: First-party build-skills docs define a skill as a directory with a `SKILL.md` that must include `name` and `description`, and say where Codex discovers skills (`.agents/skills`). They also describe a built-in skill creator and a recorder that draft new skills, so authors don't need to reverse-engineer existing ones. Community users report building their own custom skills. Missing for 10: a verbatim SKILL.md template showing the frontmatter syntax and the full field schema in the evidence.
